capabilities: Collects clipped notes into an inbox, reading and archived queue
Opens articles in a distraction-free reader mode with adjustable width, font and size
Saves and restores scroll reading progress in frontmatter
Highlights selected text as quote, insight, action or question with margin notes
Compiles highlights and notes into a summary callout at the top of the note
disambiguation: Not a clipboard manager; it reads articles saved as notes by Obsidian Web Clipper.
extras: Highlights and margin notes are written as plain Markdown (==text== %%clip-note:[category] note%%) so they stay portable; any note with a status property can enter the queue, so Web Clipper is optional.
problem: Clipped web articles pile up in the vault with no queue, no distraction-free reading view, and no way to keep reading position or annotations.

relations.evidence: Save articles to your Clippings/ folder using Obsidian Web Clipper

summary: Read-it-later reader for web-clipped articles with a reading queue, saved scroll progress, color-coded highlights and margin notes.
